{{Quote|A cargo carrier, then. There's one coming now—just behind that Trast speeder truck.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
[[Trast Heavy Transports/Legends|Trast Heavy Transports']] '''A-A5 Speeder Truck''' was designed to transport heavy cargo across rough worlds, and was covered in armored plates to protect it and its cargo from harsh environmental conditions.

==Characteristics==
The A-A5 speeder truck was manufactured by [[Trast Heavy Transports/Legends|Trast Heavy Transports]] as a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] long-distance cargo transport.<ref name="RASB" /> It measured 21.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="RASB2" /> and consisted of two sections; the cab and the cargo bay.<ref name="AEG" /> A-A5s had a ground clearance of three meters, and could reach speeds of one hundred and sixty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="RASB2" /> A-A5s were covered in armor as strong as some light military vehicles.<ref name="AEG" />

The A-A5 only required a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], but the cab had room for a crew of three. This was to allow the crew to alternating driving duties so as to extend the distance the vehicle could travel without stopping.<ref name="AEG" /> Each cab featured two folding bunks attached to the back wall.<ref name="FUCG" /> An enclosed cargo bay<ref name="AEG" /> could carry 25,000 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo, as well as twenty-five passengers<ref name="RASB" /> who were seated on<ref name="AEG" /> fold-out benches<ref name="FUCG" /> along the top of the bay.<ref name="AEG" /> A [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] worth of consumables were carried aboard.<ref name="FUCG" /> A-A5s cost between 13,600<ref name="RASB2" /> and 30,500 credits to buy new;<ref name="AEG" /> used vehicles could retail for anywhere between 7,850<ref name="RASB2" /> and 8,250 credits.<ref name="AEG" />

==History==
[[File:AA5truck-NEGVV.png|thumb|left|250px|A-A5 speeder truck profile view]]
A-A5 speeder trucks were designed to ferry cargo over long distances through rough terrain, usually among the uncivilized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AEG" /> Many were modified by militias and insurgents<ref name="FUCG" /> with heavier armor plating to act as [[Armored personnel carrier/Legends|armored personnel carriers]].<ref name="AEG" />

[[Pg'lax]], owner of the [[Quick Pit docking bay service]] service at [[Mos Eisley]], used modified A-A5 speeder trucks for his work.<ref name="Secrets">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}}</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used speeder trucks like the A-A5 as troop transports. Despite being used as combat vehicles, A-A5s were unarmed, as they were never intended to actually enter a combat zone. Some vehicles, however, "acquired" weapons including [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]],<ref name="RASB" /> or [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]]<ref name="AEG" /> hand-mounted to the body by the crews. The practice was disliked by [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] as they felt that such actions resulted in the crews taking risks they should not.<ref name="RASB" />
